the four families are probably latent application/configuration values
licensed by a page/record stencil,

The generic exemplar/stencil/cadence model remains close and is now the

## Selected value taxonomy

The four agents disagree on literal actions but converge on a useful latent
state taxonomy:

| family | selected working class | confidence | concrete subordinate glosses |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `VAL-Q` | `BASE_CONFIGURATION` | .50 | standard/ground setting; immersion only .20 |
| `VAL-QE` | `MARKED_MEDIUM_OR_APPLICATION` | .48 | circulation/throughput; tempered/warm .27 |
| `VAL-S` | `SET_OR_RESULT_STATE` | .45 | standard/as usual or hold/rest .30 |
| `VAL-L` | `LOCAL_HELD_OR_CARRIED_APPLICATION` | .43 | local/body-end use; pour/rinse .25 |

The labels describe different roles within one technical answer deck. They do
not assert that Q/QE are authorially related morphemes, nor that the source
language used these English words.

At deck level, the medical scribe's most concrete application sequence remains
useful but low-confidence:

```text
STANDARD -> TEMPERED/WARM -> POUR/RINSE -> IMMERSE/SOAK
```

This should be treated as a content palette, not a fixed order or dictionary.

Die äußere Wrapperklasse ist sogar deterministisch mit dem Wertdeck verwoben:
`Q` trägt alle 10 `VAL-QE` und 8 `VAL-Q`, `L` alle 8 `VAL-L`, und die
`S/CH/T`-Realisierungen alle 12 `VAL-S` (MI `1.509` bit). Das ist jedoch kein
unabhängiger Sachkontrollwert, sondern Teil der exakten Kartenidentität. Es
zeigt: Der Schreiber erkennt die Wertklasse an der ganzen Karte; das Bild
ersetzt sie nicht.
